policy.default: The existing individually authored Emerald Champions preset remains Set 1 and the ordinary-wild capture default.
policy.alternatives: Up to two locally legal, nonduplicate handbook sets are retained; a lone Projected set is not enough to create an alternative.
policy.held_items: Handbook items remain advisory and are never granted or equipped by the tutor.
policy.promotion: A handbook set may improve Set 1 only through a manual source-backed superiority decision recorded in default_promotions and the authored review batch.

default_promotions.reason: The handbook's M-B Belly Drum set restores powerful second STAB and prevents Water resists from blanking the default cleaner.
The handbook's M-B attacker uses reliable high-power Fighting STAB instead of target-weight-dependent damage.
